title: Mass of a Unit Cube with Linear Density Variation
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the total mass of the unit cube [0, 1]^3 if its density is delta(x, y, z) = x y z.

steps.title: Factor Triple Integral Over Cube
steps.mathExpression: M = \int_0^1 x \, dx \int_0^1 y \, dy \int_0^1 z \, dz
steps.explanation: All limits are constant and the density function factors into separate single-variable terms.
